description: "Byron" by John Nichol is a biographical account of the life and significance of the renowned poet Lord Byron, likely written in the late 19th century. The book delves into Byron's life story, exploring his ancestry, formative years, literary career, and personal relationships, shedding light on the complexities that made him a central figure in Romantic literature.
